64. Butane-fueled cigarette lighters, which give hundreds of

lights each, typically contain 4 to 5 g butane (C4H10), which is confined in a 10-mL plastic container and exerts a pres­ sure of 3.0 atm at room temperature (25°C). The butane boils at 20.5°C under normal pressure. Butane lighters have been known to explode during use, inflicting serious injury. Estimate how many grams of butane would be contained in such a lighter.
